blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained visual representations accelerate generative learning by abstracting away appearance and spatial detail. Yet the same abstraction makes the return to pixels far harder, shifting much of the burden onto a larger decoder. We ask why the representation-to-pixel path should be learned independently when the encoder already provides a learned pixel-to-semantics path (the semantic encoding path). We introduce RevFlow, based on the principle of generation as reverse encoding. RevFlow uses intermediate representations of a frozen encoder as successive generative targets, first generating deep semantic representations, then shallow representations that retain appearance and spatial detail, before decoding to pixels. To learn these transitions without training a separate generator for each stage, we develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model with a standard DiT backbone shared across stages and stage-specific condition injection. We further show that native matching in semantic representation space enables few-step generation. RevFlow accelerates both learning and sampling. On ImageNet $256 \times 256$, RevFlow reaches 1.96 FID at 690M and 1.74 FID at 1.55B after only 5 training epochs. It also achieves 30.25 dB reconstruction PSNR with an 89M decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase, RevFlow-XL achieves 2.85 FID using a single sampling step in each stage. Our code repository is at https://github.com/ChengShiest/RevFlow

blocks.en:
Visual encoding and image reconstruction/generation can be viewed as opposite processes. A pretrained visual encoder progressively transforms an image into increasingly abstract representations, whereas image reconstruction/generation maps such representations back to concrete visual realizations.
In conventional autoencoding [ 61 , 46 ] , the reverse problem is posed as reconstruction: a representation is paired with the particular image that produced it, and the decoder is trained to recover that image. Generation poses a harder reverse problem. Once abstraction makes different images share similar representations, the inverse becomes underdetermined: a representation can correspond to multiple images rather than a fixed target.
blocks.zh:
视觉编码和图像重建/生成可视为相向的过程. 预先训练的视觉编码器逐渐地将图像转化为越来越抽象的表示,而图像重建/生成则将这种表示映射回具体的视觉实现.
在常规自编码 [61, 46] 中,反向问题被提出来作为重建:一种代表与产生它的特定图像配对,而解码器则经过培训来恢复该图像. 世代产生一个更难倒转的问题。 一旦抽象化使不同的图像分享了相近的表示,反向就会变得不确定:一个表示可以对应多个图像而不是固定的目标.

blocks.en:
This distinction becomes especially pronounced for representations pretrained for visual understanding 1 1 1 In this paper, unless otherwise specified, encoder refers to a frozen pretrained visual representation encoder, such as DINO or CLIP, rather than to a reconstruction-oriented VAE encoder. . Reconstruction-oriented representations, such as VAE latents, retain appearance and spatial detail for faithful recovery, whereas semantic representations learned for visual understanding suppress variations less relevant to semantic discrimination. Such abstraction accelerates generative learning, as exploited by REPA [ 63 ] and RAE [ 66 ] , but leaves more appearance and spatial detail to be generated on the way back to pixels. In RAE-style models, this burden is delegated to a separately learned decoder, which is typically around 10 × \times larger than those in conventional latent diffusion [ 48 ] ; Figure 2 further shows that RAE can reconstruct a gray Christmas hat as red.
Abstraction therefore shifts, rather than removes, the difficulty: generation in a semantic representation space is easier to learn, while decoding becomes more demanding and absorbs an increasing share of generative modeling.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,除非另有说明,编码器是指被冻结的被预先训练的可视化编码器,如DINO或CLIP,而不是重塑取向的VAE编码器. 以重建为导向的表述,如VAE潜想,保留了表征和空间细节,以进行忠实的恢复,而为视觉理解而学习的语义表述则抑制了与语义歧视不太相干的变化. 这种抽象加速了基因学的学习,被REPA[63]和RAE[66]所利用,但在返回像素的路上留下了更多的外观和空间细节来生成. 在RAE型模型中,这种负担被委托给一个单独学习的解码器,这种解码器通常比传统潜在扩散的解码器大10xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx; 图2还显示RAE可以将灰色圣诞帽子重建为红色.
因此,抽象化会转移,而不是去除困难:在语义表达空间中的生成更容易被学习,而解码则会变得要求更高并吸收越来越多的基因模型.

blocks.en:
Recent methods mitigate this tension by making the generated representation retain more appearance and spatial detail. VA-VAE [ 61 ] enriches reconstruction-oriented latents with semantic structure, while RAEv2 [ 51 ] combines multiple encoder levels into a single target containing both semantic and spatial information.
These methods improve the target through alignment or feature aggregation, then learn a separate decoding path from that target to pixels.
blocks.zh:
最近的方法通过使产生的代表保留更多的外观和空间细节来缓解这种紧张. VA-VAE [61]用语义结构丰富了以重建为导向的潜质,而RAEv2 [51] 将多编码器水平结合为一个既包含语义信息又包含空间信息的单一目标.
这些方法通过对齐或特征聚合来改进目标,然后学习从目标到像素的单独解码路径.

blocks.en: We take a different view. Here we define the semantic encoding path as the progression of representations from pixels to abstract semantics that semantic pretraining forms within an encoder. If generation ultimately reverses semantic encoding, why learn a separate decoding path back to pixels when the semantic encoding path already connects pixels to semantics? We propose to reverse this path itself. Along the semantic encoding path, shallow representations retain more appearance and spatial detail, while deep representations emphasize semantics. The path thus acts like the forward process of diffusion models, which removes information gradually so that generation can recover it through simple reverse steps [ 52 , 21 ] . Unlike data-agnostic Gaussian corruption, which removes information roughly by spatial frequency [ 47 ] , the encoder removes it in a learned order: appearance and spatial detail first, semantics last [ 38 , 1 ] . Its reverse resolves semantics first, from deep representations that largely reveal the class, leaving representation learning, a main bottleneck of diffusion training [ 63 ] , to the pretrained encoder. Directly predicting clean shallow features from a class label faces an uninformative conditional mean and wide residual variance, forcing stiff jumps onto dispersed clean Dirac targets rather than smooth score refinement. Reversing the path keeps training smooth: the deep stage first models a lower-variance semantic space, and its output then provides spatial mean guidance that leaves only a narrow residual variance for the shallow stage (Appendix A , Sec. 4.3 ). This suggests a different principle: intermediate representations along the semantic encoding path should serve as successive generation targets, defining how generation unfolds . Generating each target, from the class label or from the next deeper representation on the path, forms a stage . How to learn stages that differ in conditions and representation spaces within one model, however, remains open.
blocks.zh: 我们的看法不同。 在这里,我们定义了语义编码路径,即从像素表达到抽象语义的进取,这些语义在编码器内预加训练. 如果一代最终将语义编码反向,那么当语义编码路径已经将像素与语义连接起来时,为什么要学习一个单独的解码路径回向像素? 我们建议扭转这条道路本身。 沿着语义编码路径,浅显性保留了更多的外观和空间细节,而深显性则强调语义. 路径因此起到类似扩散模型的前进过程的作用,它逐渐去除信息,使生成者可以通过简单的倒向步骤来恢复它[52,21]. 与数据不可知的高斯腐败不同,它大致按照空间频率去除信息[47],编码器按照学习到的顺序去除:外观和空间细节第一,语义最后一个[38, 1]. 其倒置首先解决了语义问题,从基本揭示了班级的深层表述,留下了代表学习,是传播培训的主要瓶颈[63],到被预先训练的编码器. 从一个类标签直接预测干净的浅层特征面临一个非信息化的有条件和广泛的剩余差异,迫使僵硬地跳到分散的干净的Dirac目标上,而不是平滑地完善分数. 逆行道能使训练平滑:深相相相先为下相变相的语义空间,其输出再提供空间平均取向,只为浅相留有狭长的残相(Appendix A., Sec. 4.3.). 这提出了不同的原则: 语义编码路径上的中间表示应作为相继的生成目标,定义生成方式. 产生每个目标,从类标签或从路径的下一个更深层的表示,形成一个阶段。 然而,在一种模式内如何学习条件和代表空间不同的阶段,仍然没有定论。

blocks.en:
We propose RevFlow ( generation as reverse encoding ), which carries out multiple stages of generation along the reversed semantic encoding path with a single Transformer backbone. The generation targets of all stages are representations of the same image along the path. Generation proceeds from class labels to deep semantic representations, then shallow representations, and finally pixels. Sharing a backbone across stages requires accommodating different conditions and addressing optimization interference across representation spaces. We therefore introduce HyC-DiT , which adapts a standard DiT [ 42 ] in both architecture and training: global class conditioning is used in the first stage and spatial feature conditioning in the second, while clean-target prediction enables effective weight sharing across stages.
Crucially, the deep-to-shallow stage models appearance and spatial detail before pixel decoding, reducing the generative modeling burden on the decoder. The complete pipeline pairs a lightweight decoder with better generation and reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
我们提议RevFlow(世代为倒置编码),它沿着倒置的语义编码路径进行多阶段的生成,使用单一的变形器主干线. 所有阶段的生成目标都是沿途相同形象的表示. 世代从分类标签到深语义表述,再到浅语义表述,最后到像素. 要在各个阶段共享一个支柱,就需要适应不同的条件,并解决代表空间之间的优化干扰。 因此,我们引入了HyC-DIT,在建筑和培训方面都采用了标准的DiT[42]:第一阶段采用全球班级调节,第二阶段采用空间地物调节,而清洁目标预测则能够实现不同阶段的有效重量共享。
关键的是,像素解码前的深至花相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 整条管线配有轻量级的解码器,能更好的生成和重建.

blocks.en: Beyond reverse encoding, we study native distribution matching for few-step adaptation of semantic representation generators. Existing methods such as FD-loss [ 59 ] and representation distribution matching [ 15 ] improve few-step generation by aligning generated and real samples in pretrained feature space, but conventional VAE-based generators typically need to decode latents into images and re-encode them for matching. Generating encoder representations allows native matching without this decode–encode loop. Native matching (NM) improves both single-stage RAE and two-stage RevFlow, demonstrating applicability beyond our reverse-encoding architecture.
blocks.zh: 除了反向编码之外,我们研究本土分布匹配,以适应语义表达生成器的几步适应. FD-loss [59] 等现有方法以及配对 [15] 的表示式分布,通过将生成的和真实的样本在被预先训练的地物空间中相接来改进了几步生成,但常规的以VAE为主的生成器通常需要将潜入到图像中去进行解码并重新编码进行配对. 生成编码器表达式允许本地匹配,而无需此解码-编码回路. 原生配对(NM)既改进了单相RAE,又改进了双相RevFlow,显示了我们的倒置编码架构之外的可应用性.

blocks.en: On class-conditional ImageNet 256 × \times 256, RevFlow with a standard DiT backbone reaches 1.96 FID with 690M parameters and 1.74 FID with 1.55B parameters after only 5 training epochs . For reconstruction, RevFlow achieves 30.25 dB PSNR with an 89M decoder, compared with 18.09 dB using the 415M RAE decoder. After a short native-matching adaptation phase , RevFlow-XL reaches 2.85 FID using one sampling step per stage and no CFG .
blocks.zh: 在类有条件的ImageNet 256 ×\times 256上,有标准DiT主干线的RevFlow达到1.96 FID,参数为690M;只有5个训练时代后,1.74 FID,参数为1.55B. 对于重建,RevFlow使用89M解码器实现30.25 dB PSNR,而使用415M RAE解码器的DB为18.09 dB. 经过短期本土匹配适应阶段,RevFlow-XL使用每个阶段一个取样步骤达到2.85FID,没有CFG。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We introduce generation as reverse encoding , modeling the inverse of representation encoding as a generative process that reverses the semantic encoding path of a frozen encoder from deep to shallow representations. • We develop HyC-DiT, a unified generative model that learns all stages of the reversed path with one shared Transformer backbone. It injects the class label as a global condition and the deep representation as a spatial condition through per-token AdaLN. Clean-target prediction avoids the degradation that velocity prediction suffers under sharing, matching separate generators with about half the parameters. • We show that pretrained semantic representations can serve as both generation targets and native distribution-matching spaces. Native matching enables few-step adaptation in both single-stage RAE and two-stage RevFlow without pixel decoding or re-encoding. • We provide a fast-converging training recipe that achieves 1.96/1.74 FID with standard DiT backbones on ImageNet 256 × 256 256\times 256 after only five epochs, making high-quality generative modeling more accessible for rapid experimentation.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们引入了生成作为逆向编码,将代表编码的反向模拟为从深到浅的表示来逆转被冻结的编码器的语义编码路径的基因过程. ^ 我们开发了HyC-DIT,一个统一的基因模型,用一个共享的变形器骨干来学习倒转路径的各个阶段. 它通过每个托肯AdaLN注入类标签作为全球条件并注入深层代表作为空间条件. 清洁目标预测避免了速度预测在共享下受到的退化,将单独的发电机与大约一半的参数相匹配。 我们显示,经过预先训练的语义表现既可以作为生成目标,也可以作为本土分布匹配空间. 原生匹配可以在单相的RAE和双相的RevFlow中实现几步适应,而无需像素解码或再编码. ^ 我们提供一种快速接合的训练食谱,在图像网256×256\times 256上使用标准的DiT主干线实现1.96/1.74 FID,仅经过了五个纪元,使得高质量的基因模型更便于快速实验.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Target spaces for generation. Diffusion and flow models [ 21 , 53 , 35 , 36 , 2 , 42 , 37 ] are trained either in pixel space [ 12 , 23 , 32 ] or in the latents of reconstruction-trained tokenizers [ 29 , 56 , 14 , 48 ] . Recent work brings in semantics from pretrained encoders: VA-VAE [ 61 ] and REPA [ 63 ] align VAE latents or diffusion hidden states with frozen encoder features, REPA-E [ 30 ] tunes the VAE end to end, and other tokenizers are designed for generation [ 60 , 64 ] . RAE [ 66 ] generates final-layer encoder features directly, and RAEv2 [ 51 ] fuses several layers into one latent. All of them generate a single target and leave the rest to a separately learned decoder, which absorbs more of the synthesis as the target becomes more abstract. RevFlow instead distributes generation across successive levels of the encoder hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 目标空间为生成。 传播和流动模型[21、53、35、36、2、42、37]要么接受像素空间[12、23、32]的培训,要么接受重建培训的活化剂[29、56、14、48]的潜在训练。 最近的工作从预先训练的编码器中引入了语义学:VA-VAE[61]和REPA[63]使VAE潜想或扩散的隐藏状态与冷冻编码器特征相配合,REPA-E[30]调用VAE端来结束,而其他活化器则设计用于生成 [60,64]. RAE [66] 直接生成最终层编码器特性,RAEv2 [51] 将多层熔接成一个潜伏. 它们都产生出一个单一的目标,剩下的留给一个单独学习的解码器,随着目标变得更加抽象,它吸收了更多的合成. RevFlow转而将生成分配到编码器分级的相继层次.

blocks.en: Inverting visual representations. Feature inversion [ 38 , 13 ] shows that deeper layers become increasingly invariant, retaining semantics while losing appearance and spatial detail; pretrained Vision Transformers [ 7 , 39 , 50 , 20 ] follow a similar trend. In our ImageNet retrieval examples, shallow features match color and texture, while deep features more often retrieve images of the same class. Such inversions, like autoencoder and RAE decoders, are deterministic regressions. Because encoding is many-to-one, RevFlow models each inversion step generatively and uses deterministic pixel decoding only at a shallow level that retains image detail.
blocks.zh: 倒相相相显相. 地貌倒转 [38,13] 显示更深的地层变得越来越无常,保留了语义,同时失去了外观和空间细节;被预先训练的"视觉变换器"[7,39,50,20]也遵循了类似的趋势. 在我们的ImageNet检索实例中,浅的特征匹配颜色和纹理,而深的特征则更经常地检索同一类的图像. 这种倒置,如自编码器和RAE解码器,是决定性的回归. 因为编码是多到一的,RevFlow模型每个倒置步骤都是基因化的,并且只在保留图像细节的浅层上使用定型像素解码.

blocks.en: Multi-stage and representation-conditioned generation. Coarse-to-fine generators decompose synthesis across resolutions [ 27 , 46 , 22 , 19 , 55 ] . Others first generate a compact representation before synthesizing the image: unCLIP [ 45 ] samples CLIP embeddings, RCG [ 33 ] generates self-supervised representations, W"urstchen [ 43 ] generates a compressed semantic latent, and Latent Forcing [ 3 ] denoises features ahead of pixels. In these methods, the representation conditions generation in another space; in RevFlow, successive targets are paired features from a single frozen encoder, each stage reverses one segment of the encoding path, and all stages share a common backbone. For spatial conditioning, HyC-DiT follows spatially adaptive normalization [ 41 ] rather than using auxiliary control branches [ 65 ] , computing adaLN-Zero parameters on a per-token basis.

blocks.en: Few-step generation and distribution matching. Few-step generators can be obtained through distillation [ 49 , 62 ] , consistency training [ 54 ] , or average-velocity modeling [ 16 ] . Generators can also be trained by matching distributions in fixed feature spaces, from maximum mean discrepancy [ 18 , 34 ] to recent objectives defined on pretrained representations [ 59 , 15 , 11 ] . For latent-space generators, such representation-based matching requires decoding generated latents to pixels and re-encoding them into the matching space; RevFlow instead generates encoder representations directly and matches them natively.
blocks.zh: 少步生成和发行匹配. 通过蒸馏[49,62],一致性培训[54],或平均速度模型[16],可以得到的分步发电机很少. 发电机还可以通过在固定特性空间的分布相匹配来进行培训,从最大平均相差[18,34]到最近确定在预先训练的表示上的目标[59,15,11]. 对于潜在的空间生成器,这种基于表示的匹配需要解码生成的潜入像素并重新编码到匹配的空间; RevFlow转而直接生成编码器的表示并本土匹配.

Deep representations emphasize semantics, while shallow representations retain more appearance and spatial detail. RevFlow divides the reversed path into multiple stages, generating deep and then shallow representations before pixel decoding (Figure 4 a).
We address three design questions: which representation levels define the generation targets (Sec. 3.1 ); how a unified model shares its Transformer backbone across stages through suitable conditioning and prediction parameterization (Secs. 3.2 – 3.3 ); and how native matching enables one-step sampling per stage (Sec. 3.4 ).

blocks.en: Both stages use clean-target prediction [ 32 ] as defined in Eq. ( 3 ). For either representation target, the model could instead predict the corresponding velocity field. These parameterizations describe the same flow but differ in optimization under parameter sharing. Clean-target prediction outputs denoised representations anchored near their conditional means 𝔼 ⁡ [ 𝒛 ℓ | 𝒄 ℓ ] \mathbb{E}[\boldsymbol{z}^{\ell}|\boldsymbol{c}^{\ell}] in both stages, whereas velocity prediction couples stage-specific residuals with high-dimensional noise ϵ ℓ \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{\ell} (Appendix A ), causing interference in a shared backbone. Figure 5 shows that clean-target prediction retains comparable quality with shared and separate networks (1.96 vs. 1.92 FID), while reducing parameters from 1.361B to 690M. Velocity prediction instead degrades from 2.07 to 4.25 FID under sharing, motivating our choice of clean-target prediction.

We describe one-step-per-stage adaptation for two-stage RevFlow below and evaluate single-stage RAE in Sec. 4.2 .

blocks.en: For the five-epoch ImageNet runs, we train RevFlow-XL and RevFlow-H with Muon [ 26 ] and AdamW at a global batch size of 256. We compute FID on 50,000 generated images (50 per class) using ImageNet training-set reference statistics.

blocks.en: Target layers. An additional shallow-depth study scans shallow targets in DINOv3-S with the deep target fixed at L12 and an 87.12M-parameter decoder. Moving the shallow target from L1 to L3 and L5 improves FID from 4.36 to 3.14 and 2.69, while reconstruction PSNR decreases from 30.19 to 28.32 and 25.48 dB. blocks.en: Setup and baseline. Because published methods use different datasets, we reproduce RAE under our training setup and compare both methods at the same resolution from 5k to 35k iterations. Table 5 includes published latent- and pixel-space models for context, with our reproduced RAE as the primary baseline.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: RevFlow models the reverse of a frozen encoder hierarchy as successive generative transitions, improving convergence and reconstruction with a Transformer backbone shared across stages and a lightweight pixel decoder. Clean-target prediction enables effective parameter sharing, while native representation matching supports one-step generation per stage without pixel decoding and re-encoding during adaptation. These results establish encoder hierarchies as useful structure for organizing image generation.
blocks.zh: RevFlow模式是将被冻结的编码器结构倒置为相继的基因过渡,通过跨阶段共享的变形器骨干和轻量级像素解码器来改进趋同和重建. 清洁目标预测能够有效共享参数,而本土代表比对则支持每个阶段的一步生成,在适应过程中没有像素解码和再编码. 这些结果确立了编码分级,作为组织图像生成的有用结构.

blocks.en: The analysis predicts the outcome of each ablation under the same five-epoch recipe (Table 4 ). • Removing the deep level ( Prop. A ). Generating the same shallow target directly from the class leaves all of V ⁡ ( 𝒂 | y ) V(\boldsymbol{a}|y) to a single stage under weak mean guidance ( R 2 = 4.2 % R^{2}=4.2\% ) . FID degrades from 1.96 to 15.94 with the target and decoder unchanged (Table 4 a). • Moving the shallow level (C1). With the same decoder architecture, moving the DINOv3-S shallow target from layer 1 to 3 and 5 narrows the gap to the deep level and raises the reconstruction floor: FID improves from 4.36 to 3.14 and 2.69, while PSNR drops from 30.19 to 28.32 and 25.48 dB. • Decoding the deep level . On DINOv3-L with a matched 89M decoder, decoding 𝒛 23 L \boldsymbol{z}^{L}_{23} directly ( 𝒛 23 L → 𝒙 \boldsymbol{z}^{L}_{23}\!\to\!\boldsymbol{x} ) drops PSNR from 30.25 to 19.87 dB and worsens FID from 1.96 to 2.65 (Table 4 a). Similarly, the final-layer RAE latent of DINOv2-B gives 18.09 dB PSNR with a 415M decoder and changes the hat color in Fig. 2 . • Adding a level and condition noise . A third stage at layer 16 (within the late regime) raises FID from 1.96 to 2.51 (Table 4 a); here the accumulated guidance drift of the extra factor outweighs the shorter gaps. Removing condition noise ( σ = 0 \sigma=0 ) similarly degrades FID from 1.96 to 2.10 (Table 4 c). • Replacing the shallow level with a VAE latent. Generating SD-VAE latents from the same deep level gives 2.94 FID (Table 4 a). Unlike 𝒉 7 \boldsymbol{h}^{7} , VAE latents are not part of the encoder path that produces 𝒉 23 \boldsymbol{h}^{23} . The optimization recipe also contributes to this speed.
